## Summary

Describe the outcome and why it belongs in Dart Room.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `npm run test:site` when routing, metadata, assets, or build behavior changed
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` when gameplay, interaction, accessibility, or presentation changed

List any additional manual checks:

## Screenshots or recordings

Include before-and-after evidence for visible changes, or write “Not applicable.”

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no generated build artifacts.
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior or a reproduced regression where practical.
- [ ] Documentation reflects player-facing or architectural changes.
- [ ] Keyboard, touch, responsive layout, and reduced motion were considered.
- [ ] I have read and followed `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the Code of Conduct.
